page.overview:
Who is Flaming Garbage Martian?

The Flaming Garbage Martian is a Martian who was turned into a barrel of flaming garbage by Magic Man some time before his banishment from Mars. Despite being cursed in an inanimate form, she is able to talk. Following the death of Grob Gob Glob Grod, Martian society degraded and Martians kept themselves warm with her flames. Upon Magic Man's return as Normal Man, she as well as another Martian who was turned into a giant starfish called him out for his atrocities. To appease them, Normal Man conjured a pack of brownies from a top hat that she wanted to eat.

After Magic Man became King of Mars, it can assumed that all was forgiven between them, though it's unknown if she was turned back to normal.

She is a rusted metal drum barrel with flames burning out of the opening and resembles nothing like the rest of her people.
